specs.label: Options
specs.value: 100/1000BASE-T RJ45 and 100/1000BASE SFP in sets of four

part_number.note: No positional Model Option Table available. The SEL-2731 IM (2731_IM_20240930.pdf, Table 3 'Ordering Options') lists the configurable dimensions but does not document a per-digit part-number encoding, no ordering-information MOT was used, and no genuine part number was found to calibrate against (the model_to_layers data for i7295.A.pdf is tokenized layer-name text with no source.position anchors, so it is unusable for positioning). Configurable ordering dimensions per the IM are: conformal coat (Yes/No); Power Supply Position One and Position Two, each Low Voltage 24-48 Vdc or High Voltage 125-250 Vdc / 120-240 Vac; Communication Ports options 1-8 (mixes of 100/1000BASE SFP, 100/1000BASE-T copper, 100BASE SFP, 100BASE-T copper); Ethernet switching technology (RSTP standard, Unmanaged future, OT SDN OpenFlow); Mounting (Rack / Panel / Surface). Covered-connector kit accessory 915900661. positions left empty because these cannot be mapped to fixed part-number digit positions without a genuine part number or ordering-information template.
references: SEL-2731 Ethernet Switch Manual (2731_IM_20240930.pdf, Table 3 Ordering Options, pp.6-7)
